Bea (Docs): Small docs PR to clarify the CLI and SDK examples for Dedicated provisioning: adding a compact CLI flag example for fallback-priority and clarifying that tenant_label replaces tenant_hint. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012

Ibrahim (Eng-Platform): Paste the CLI and SDK bits here and I'll run linkcheck and a quick local build. Also which anchors did you touch?

Bea (Docs): CLI example:
```sh
redwood infra create-pool --name "evening-burst" --tenant-label team-55 --min 2 --max 8 --schedule "Mon-Fri:18:00-22:00" --fallback-priority rdm-medium-v2,rdm-small-quant-v1
```
JS SDK (short):
```js
await client.dedicated.createPool({ name: 'evening-burst', tenant_label: 'team-55', min_replicas: 2, max_replicas: 8, fallback_priority: ['rdm-medium-v2','rdm-small-quant-v1'] });
```
Python SDK (explicit):
```py
client.dedicated.create_pool(name='evening-burst', tenant_label='team-55', min_replicas=2, max_replicas=8, fallback_priority=['rdm-medium-v2','rdm-small-quant-v1'])
```
Anchors added: #cli-reserved-pool-example and #fallback-priority-note. Replaced #tenant-hint -> #tenant-label in crosslinks.

Claire (Eng-ML): Quick note: add a single sentence about quality expectations when a quantized fallback is chosen. Something like: "Quantized fallbacks reduce latency and memory but may impact output quality; include fallback models in evals." Also ensure code uses tenant_label everywhere.

Nora (Product): SLA wording check: avoid implying fallback is prevented for reserved pools unless pinned. Suggest: "Fallback behavior may be invoked under sustained capacity pressure; reserved pools with pin=true are excluded from overflow selection."

Ibrahim (Eng-Platform): Running local linkcheck. Found one leftover `tenant_hint` in api-reference/cli.md; I'll push a tiny commit to the branch to update that. Also fixed a broken TOC link that pointed to #fallbacks instead of #fallback-priority-note.

site-bot: linkcheck started for PR #1012

Bea (Docs): Thanks — I've updated the migration note under "Upgrading SDKs": "If you previously used tenant_hint, set tenant_label to the same value. See migration helper examples." Kept phrasing per Product suggestion.

Claire (Eng-ML): Optional: add a one-liner runtime note: "runtime chooses first model in fallback_priority that fits memory/latency budget." Helps users reason about ordering.

Ibrahim (Eng-Platform): CI: linkcheck ✓, build ✓, markdown-lint warnings: 1 (line length). I pushed a small line-wrap fix.

Nora (Product): LGTM on the revised SLA sentence and migration wording.

Bea (Docs): Great, merging after CI green. I'll follow up with a tiny PR adding a Python migration helper and a short eval checklist for fallback models.
